meta.title: CampusInterface with Public LMS
meta.description: The CampusInterface block theme with the Public LMS plugin and ten demo courses: an academy home page, the course catalogue, lessons and a learner dashboard.
meta.author: WPInterface

options.blogdescription: Practical courses taught by people who do the work

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// Front page: the theme's academy home pattern on a page without a title.
$home = wp_insert_post(
	array(
		'post_type'     => 'page',
		'post_status'   => 'publish',
		'post_title'    => 'Academy home',
		'post_name'     => 'academy-home',
		'page_template' => 'page-no-title',
		'post_content'  => '<!-- wp:pattern {"slug":"campusinterface/page-academy-home"} /-->',
	)
);
update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
update_option( 'page_on_front', $home );

// Main menu: the course catalogue and the learner's dashboard.
wp_insert_post(
	array(
		'post_type'    => 'wp_navigation',
		'post_status'  => 'publish',
		'post_title'   => 'Main menu',
		'post_content' => '<!-- wp:navigation-link {"label":"Courses","url":"/courses/","kind":"custom"} /--><!-- wp:navigation-link {"label":"My learning","url":"/my-learning/","kind":"custom"} /-->',
	)
);
